newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pertamina delays turnaround of Dumai refinery.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina delays turnaround of Dumai refinery.

text.p: Indonesia's state-owned Pertamina plans to shut its 120,000-barrel-per-day Dumai refinery from mid-February 1997, instead of November this year as initially scheduled, a refinery source said on Monday.
The maintenance shutdown will last for about 37 days, he said.
The source said the reason for deferring the shutdown was because the Dumai refinery had undergone maintenance at one of its hydrocracking units between December 22, 1995 and January 22 this year.
"We want to let one year pass before having another maintenance," he said.
The latest shutdown will involve its crude distillation unit and another hydrocracker which has a capacity of 27,900 bpd, as well as some other secondary units.
The Dumai refinery is located in central Sumatra.
